The shortest tree is 6 feet tall. The second tree is 5 feet taller than the shortest tree, so its height is $ 6 + 5 = 11 $ feet. The height of the tallest tree is twice the sum of the heights of the two trees, so it is $ 2 \times (6 + 11) = 2 \times 17 = 34 $ feet.

FINAL_ANSWER: 34
